input: How many days of earned leave and casual leave do I get per year?
actual_output:
Earned Leave: 18 days per year (eligible after completing 6 months of service).
Casual Leave: 8 days per year.
expected_output: You get 18 days of Earned Leave (EL) per year, which is eligible after completing 6 months of service, and 8 days of Casual Leave (CL) per year. Casual leave cannot be carried forward; only Earned Leave of up to 30 days can be carried forward to the next year.
retrieval_context:
Rewritten query:
    How many days of earned leave and casual leave does an employee receive per year?

    Evidence:
    Yearly Leave Summary
Total paid leave per year (EL + CL + SL): 36 days, excluding public holidays.

General Rules
- Leave must be requested at least 2 working days in advance, except sick or emergency leave.
- Leave is calculated on a calendar year basis (January 1 to December 31).
- Leaves lapsed at the end of the year may not be carried forward except EL, as mentioned above.
- Employees under notice period may take leave only with approval of HR and manager.

Leave FAQ
- How many days of sick leave do I get? 10 days per year.
- How many casual leaves can I take? 8 per year.
- Can I carry forward my casual leave? No, only Earned Leave up to 30 days can be carried forward.
- How do I apply for leave? Go to the Employee Portal > Leave > Apply Leave > select type and dates > submit for manager approval.
- Whom do I contact for leave issues? hr@novatech.example or the HR Helpdesk.

Types of Leave
1. Earned Leave (EL): 18 days per year. Eligible after completing 6 months of service. Can be encashed up to a maximum of 5 days per year. Unused EL of up to 30 days can be carried forward to the next year.
2. Casual Leave (CL): 8 days per year. Meant for short, unplanned absences. Cannot be carried forward. At least 1 day advance notice is expected unless it is an emergency.
3. Sick Leave (SL): 10 days per year. For illness or medical appointments. A medical certificate is required if sick leave is taken for more than 2 consecutive days. Cannot be carried forward.
4. Maternity Leave: 26 weeks (with full pay) as per the Maternity Benefit Act. Can be taken not earlier than 8 weeks before the expected delivery date. Cannot be encashed.
5. Paternity Leave: 10 days of paid leave for new fathers, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth.
6. Adoption Leave: 12 weeks of paid leave when adopting a child below 1 year of age.

7. Bereavement Leave: 3 paid days in the case of death of a family member (spouse, parents, children, or in-laws).
8. Marriage Leave: 3 paid days, applicable within 3 months of the marriage date.
9. Comp-off: For work performed on a public holiday or on a weekly off. 1 full day of comp-off is granted and must be availed within 30 days.
10. Public/National Holidays: 12 gazetted holidays are observed as per the official holiday calendar released every year in January.

Working Hours
Standard working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM with a one-hour lunch break between 1:00 PM and 2:00 PM. Lunch breaks are flexible with team arrangement. Overtime is not a practice, however critical project work may require extra hours which will be compensated with comp-off (see Leave Policy).

Attendance
Attendance is marked daily through the biometric system or the mobile attendance app when working from home. Employees must mark attendance on entering and leaving the office. Late arrival beyond 15 minutes is recorded as half-day casual leave after 3 late punches in a calendar month.

LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT - NovaTech Solutions Private Limited

Learning is a core benefit at NovaTech. Every employee gets time and budget to grow skills.

Learning Budget
- INR 25,000 per year for every employee on courses, books, certifications, and conferences.
- The budget covers the full cost of work-related training. Unused budget does not carry forward.
- Courses must be approved by the manager. Requests are made through Employee Portal > Learning > Course Request.

Training Hours and Learning Days
- Every employee is expected to complete at least 5 days (40 hours) of learning per year.
- Learning days are treated as working days; no leave deduction for approved training.
- Manager-approved study time during business hours of up to 4 hours per week is available.

input: What is the password requirement for company accounts?
actual_output:
As per the IT and Security Policy:

1. Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and include upper case, lower case, numbers, and special characters.
2. Passwords must be changed every 90 days.
3. You must never reuse the last 5 passwords.
expected_output: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include upper case, lower case, numbers, and special characters. Passwords must be changed every 90 days and you must never reuse the last 5 passwords. All company accounts must also use Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
retrieval_context:
Rewritten query:
    What are the company account password requirements and security standards?

    Evidence:
    Passwords and Authentication
- All company accounts must use Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Set up MFA on day 1 for your email and SSO accounts.
- Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include upper case, lower case, numbers, and special characters.
- Passwords must be changed every 90 days. Never reuse the last 5 passwords.
- In case of a suspected compromise, immediately report to security@novatech.example and change your password.

Device Management
- All devices must have the company antivirus (SentinelOne) installed and be kept updated (auto-updates enable).
- Keep your device encrypted (BitLocker/FileVault enabled by default).
- Do not install unauthorized software. Software requests go through the IT approval workflow.
- Report a lost or stolen device to IT within 2 hours; the device is remotely wiped if needed.

IT AND SECURITY POLICY - NovaTech Solutions Private Limited

Purpose
This policy protects company data, systems, and employees from cyber threats. All employees must read and acknowledge this policy during onboarding and annually.

Acceptable Use of Company Devices and Systems
- Company-issued laptops, phones, and accounts must be used for business purposes. Minor personal use is acceptable but should not interfere with work.
- Do not store personal or non-company confidential data on company devices beyond incidental amounts.
- Company accounts (email, VPN, project tools) are for official use. Sharing passwords is strictly prohibited.

Work from Home Security
- Connect to office networks only through the company VPN (Cisco Secure Client).
- Ensure home WiFi uses WPA2/3 encryption and a strong password.
- Do not leave laptops unattended in public places. Use laptop privacy screens when traveling.
- Print confidential documents only in the office, not on home printers.

Incident Response
- Any security incident (malware, phishing, data breach, lost device) must be reported within 4 hours to security@novatech.example.
- Attempts to bypass security controls, or knowingly exposing data, lead to disciplinary action including possible termination.

IT Security FAQ
- How do I set up MFA? Go to the identity portal, scan the QR code, and register your authenticator app.
- What is the password length requirement? Minimum 12 characters.
- Can I use my personal laptop for work? Only in exception cases with IT approval.
- Whom to contact for IT issues? ithelpdesk@novatech.example or raise a ticket on the portal.

Data Classification and Handling
- Data is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted.
- Customer data is Confidential or Restricted. It must never leave approved systems, be emailed externally, or be copied to personal devices.
- Personal/sensitive employee information is Restricted and accessible only to HR and authorized payroll team.
- Use the official data-sharing tool (SharePoint) for sharing; do not use unauthorized file-sharing services for company data.
- Clean desk policy: lock your screen when away (Windows key + L), do not leave confidential documents unattended.

Internet and Email Security
- Do not click suspicious links or open unexpected attachments. Report phishing to security@novatech.example.
- Company email is monitored for security compliance.
- Browsing of inappropriate or illegal content is prohibited and is a disciplinary offense.

Onboarding Process (First 90 Days)
Day 1: You will receive your laptop, ID card, email account, and other access. Attend the HR induction session explaining policies, benefits, and portal usage.
Week 1: Meet your manager and team, complete system access setup, and complete mandatory trainings on data security, POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment), and workplace ethics.
Month 1: Onboarding buddy is assigned. First 30-60-90 day goals are discussed. You will receive your joining kit and access to all internal tools.
Month 3: First performance feedback session.

Documents Required on Joining
- Proof of identity (Aadhaar/Passport/PAN)
- Educational certificates (final degree)
- Address proof
- Previous employer relieving letter and last 3 months payslips
- Bank account details for salary
- A recent passport-size photograph

input: How much is the daily allowance for domestic travel?
actual_output: As per the Travel Expense Policy, the daily allowance for domestic travel is INR 900 per day.
expected_output: For domestic travel, the per diem is INR 900 per day toward food and incidental expenses. No receipt is needed for per diem up to 6 hours (half-day); full-day rules apply as per the portal. Claims must be pre-approved where applicable and submitted within 30 days.
retrieval_context:
Rewritten query:
    What is the daily allowance rate for domestic travel?

    Evidence:
    Travel Expense FAQ
- How much is the daily allowance for domestic travel? INR 900 per day.
- Can I claim personal cab fares? No, only business-related transport is payable.
- What if I lose a receipt? Submit an affidavit; claims above INR 2,000 without receipt need department head approval.
- Whom to contact for expense issues? finance@novatech.example.

Per Diem and Daily Allowance
- Domestic travel: INR 900 per day toward food and incidental expenses. No receipt needed for per diem up to 6 hours (half-day) and full-day rules apply as per portal.
- International travel: The per diem differs by country and is published on the travel page.

Expenses Covered
- Air, rail, bus, and cab fares
- Hotel stay and boarding
- Meals beyond the per diem when a client meeting is involved (subject to approval)
- Courier charges for business documents
- Registration fees for business conferences (pre-approved)
- Internet/mobile data while travelling on assignment

Expenses Not Covered
- Personal expenses such as personal shopping, movies, alcoholic beverages, personal phone usage beyond the plan
- Fines (traffic/parking) incurred on personal vehicles
- Expenses without receipts
- Expenses claimed after 30 days without justification

TRAVEL AND EXPENSE POLICY - NovaTech Solutions Private Limited

Scope
This policy applies to business travel and office-related expenses incurred by employees. Claims are reimbursable only when pre-approved where applicable, supported with valid receipts, and claimed within 30 days.

Travel Booking
- Domestic and international travel must be booked through the corporate travel portal or approved agency. Self-booking is allowed only for amounts under INR 5,000 for transit (auto/cab) and only if cheaper.
- Flight bookings: Economy class is standard. Business class requires the approval of the department head.
- Hotel: 3-star or business hotels up to INR 4,500 per night (domestic). International hotels as per the country-specific limit provided in the portal.
- Trains/Air: For journeys below 800 km by rail, 2nd AC is permitted for managers and above; 3AC for others.

Claim Process
1. Add expense entries in the Employee Portal > Reimbursements module, attaching digital receipts.
2. Submit the claim; it must be approved by the reporting manager and then Finance within 7 working days.
3. Approved claims are settled in the next payroll cycle or via direct transfer on a weekly basis, whichever is earlier.

Reimbursement Limits (Quick Reference)
- Cab within city for official work: approved daily or free pool usage.
- Medical reimbursement: INR 15,000/year.
- Telephone reimbursement: INR 20,000/year.
- Conference registration: pre-approved, no fixed cap.
- Client entertainment/dinner: INR 1,500 per person with advance approval from department head.

Advances
- Travel advance up to INR 50,000 can be requested for business trips, to be settled with bills within 15 days of return. Advances are deducted from salary if not settled.

Payslips and Tax
- Payslip is generated on the Employee Portal on the last working day of each month. Employees can log in and download PDF payslips from the payroll section.
- Form 16 for the previous financial year is available on the portal by 15th June every year.
- Tax is deducted at source (TDS) as per income tax rules. Employees can submit investment declarations (e.g., 80C, HRA rent proof, medical insurance) in the portal during April, or November-December window for revision.
- Tax refund/adjustment, if any, happens while processing February salary.

Deductions
Standard monthly deductions include: PF (12% of Basic), Professional Tax, and income tax as applicable. Voluntary deductions (meal cards, employee loan repayments, insurance premium) are made if opted.

input: What is the minimum tenure required for a promotion?
actual_output:
As per the Performance Policy:

1. Minimum tenure in the current role: 18 months
2. Minimum tenure for exceptional or outstanding performers: 12 months
expected_output: To be eligible for a promotion you need a minimum of 18 months in your current role at the time of the review cycle, or 12 months for outstanding performers. Promotion is based on ratings (last 2 cycles average 4 or above), skills, and business need, and is approved by a promotion committee.
retrieval_context:
Rewritten query:
    What is the minimum tenure required for an employee to be eligible for a promotion?

    Evidence:
    Performance FAQ
- When is the appraisal? April every year, mid-year review in October.
- What is the bonus percentage? Target 10% of annual CTC, scaled by rating.
- Minimum tenure for promotion? 18 months in the current role, or 12 months for exceptional performers.
- How do I give self-assessment? Employee Portal > Appraisal > Self Assessment.

Promotions
- Promotion reviews happen twice a year (April and October) along with the review cycle.
- Eligibility: minimum 18 months in current role at the time of review cycle (12 months for outstanding performers).
- Promotion is based on ratings (last 2 cycles average 4 or above), skills, and business need. A promotion committee approves all promotions.
- In the same cycle, an employee can be promoted only one level up. Promotions are effective from the 1st of the next month and come with a salary revision decided by HR and the manager.

Appeals
If you disagree with your rating, you may appeal to HR within 7 days of the rating communication. The appeal is reviewed by the department head and an HR representative.

Retirement and Financial Benefits
1. Provident Fund (PF): 12% of basic salary is contributed by the employee and an equal 12% is contributed by the company. Amount is deducted monthly from salary.
2. Gratuity: As per the Payment of Gratuity Act - eligible after 5 years of continuous service. Gratuity = Last drawn Basic + DA x 15 / 26 x number of years of service.
3. Professional Tax: Small monthly deduction as applicable per Karnataka state rules.
4. Tax-saving reimbursements: Medical reimbursement up to INR 15,000 per year and telephone reimbursement up to INR 20,000 per year against bills.

Learning and Growth Benefits
1. Learning budget: INR 25,000 per year per employee for courses, certifications, and books (see Learning & Development policy).
2. Certification bonus: INR 10,000 one-time bonus on completing select professional certifications.

Career Growth Framework
- Career tracks: Individual Contributor (IC) and Manager tracks; technical roles have parallel growth (Engineer -> Senior -> Lead -> Architect -> Principal).
- Career roadmap discussions happen during the mid-year and annual reviews.
- Internal job postings are advertised first before external hiring; employees can apply after 18 months in their current role (with manager approval).

Mentorship Program
- Every employee under 2 years of experience is assigned a mentor from a senior level.
- Mentor meetings are recommended once every 2 weeks at 30 minutes.
- Contact the L&D team at lnd@novatech.example to request a mentor or become one.

Other Perks
1. Meal vouchers: Free lunch coupons on the days you work from office (up to INR 200 per working day).
2. Transport: Company cab service within a 15 km radius of the office for late-evening shifts ending after 9 PM.
3. Employee Referral Bonus: INR 40,000 for a successful referral who is hired and stays for 6 months.
4. Annual performance bonus: Paid as per the Performance Review policy, percentage decided on rating.
5. Work anniversary gift: A gift of employee's choice (merchandise or vouchers) on every work anniversary.

Benefits FAQ
- What is the medical insurance cover? INR 8,00,000 per year for self and dependents.
- Do I get a Provident Fund? Yes, 12% company contribution on top of your PF deduction.
- Is the premium waived for mental health counseling? Yes, up to 4 sessions per year are fully paid.
- How do I claim reimbursement? Submit invoices/bills from the Employee Portal > Reimbursements module.
